notes.rationale: Bitstream J is hardware-fixed; live FPGA portion is a latency/health probe only. KL is measured between the in-process software parallel-Glauber sampler and single-site Gibbs on a 12-spin frustrated antiferromagnetic ring, the canonical small case where parallel Glauber loses detailed balance.
notes.future_work: Programmable-J KV260 bitstream + on-board KL measurement against the same J_frustrated would replace kl_measurement_mode='software_parallel_glauber_proxy' with 'live_fpga_measurement'.
